## Usage

Agent compares current skill count to last scanned count. When agent detects new skills:
1. Agent reads new skill files
2. Agent verifies STE compliance
3. Agent updates this index with new entries
4. Agent sets `last_scanned` timestamp

Agent runs validation when `last_scanned` timestamp is >7 days old.
